text:
leo: Kicked off nebula-lite-2m onboarding tests today. comparing float16 baseline vs int8 and int4 (weights-only and weights+acts). posting quick thread for results and next steps.
maria: nice. which eval suite and seed?
leo: semantic-holdout-v4, seed=7. batch 512 for throughput sims.
jin: can you paste the run commands so I can reproduce?
leo: sure:```
./eval_suite 
  --model nebula-lite-2m 
  --modes float16,int8-w, int8-w+a, int4-w 
  --dataset semantic-holdout-v4 
  --seed 7 
  --norm l2 
  --batch 512 
  --report-path /tmp/nebula_eval_3789
```
leo: TL;DR: int8-w nearly matches float16 for recall@10 (0.89 -> 0.88), int8-w+a drops to 0.84, int4-w is pretty rough (0.78). cluster purity and mean reciprocal rank (MRR) follow similar trends. full numbers below.
maria: can you share the short table?
leo:```
Metric | float16 | int8-w | int8-w+a | int4-w
recall@1 | 0.71 | 0.70 | 0.66 | 0.60
recall@5 | 0.85 | 0.84 | 0.79 | 0.72
recall@10 | 0.89 | 0.88 | 0.84 | 0.78
MRR | 0.62 | 0.60 | 0.56 | 0.49
cluster_purity | 0.48 | 0.46 | 0.41 | 0.35
mean_cosine_shift_pos | 0.012 | 0.014 | 0.030 | 0.055
```
jin: int8-w+a hurting more than I expected. did you try activation clipping or recalc stats with running median?
leo: activation clipping (0.999 quantile) was tried for int8-w+a in a follow-up run - improved recall@10 0.84 -> 0.86 but still behind weights-only.
jin: interesting. maybe tiny models with LN after projection have activation spikes that break per-tensor scales. did you inspect per-layer activation ranges?
maria: also curious about kNN stability across cohorts. any cohort-wise drops?
leo: yes - plotted per-cohort recall@10. tail cohort (long-tail queries) suffers most: int8-w+a recall@10 drop ~0.08 relative to float16. mid/high-frequency cohorts largely stable. dashboard: https://redwood-internal/embeds/nebula-lite-2m/onboard/3789
eval-bot: Job 98321 finished: nebula-lite-2m quick-onboard (float16,int8,int4)  artifacts -> dashboard.
infra-bot: note: runners were using node pool small-gpu-3; memory pressure occured during int4 runs and we throttled concurrency.
leo: ran a per-layer cosine delta script jin suggested. layer 5 projection shows the largest shift (mean delta 0.12 vs others <0.03). suspect quantizing the projection out weights plus fused GELU scaling.
jin: can you post the layerwise snippet?
leo:```
layer,mean_cosine_delta,std
0,0.01,0.02
1,0.02,0.03
2,0.01,0.01
3,0.03,0.04
4,0.04,0.05
5,0.12,0.09
6,0.02,0.02
```
maria: that points to a targeted mitigation: try per-channel quant for the projection layer only (mixed quant), or leave that layer in float16 and quantize rest.
leo: I did a mixed run: keep layer5 float16, quantize others int8-w+a. recall@10 improved to 0.88 and MRR to 0.60. int4 mixed (keep layer5 float16) also gave a +0.05 bump but still below production.
jin: solid! that's a pragmatic path for canary. also measure latency delta: what are tail P95 numbers for mixed vs float16?
leo: measured on sampled prod-like traffic (100k queries): float16 P95=23ms, int8-w P95=19ms, mixed int8-w+a-with-layer5-fp16 P95=20ms. so perf wins without big tail latency hit.
maria: action items: 1) run a focused ablation where we try per-channel quant on layer5 weights (if supported) and do activation clipping. 2) prepare a short canary plan (sampled traffic + recall monitoring + fallback). 3) update onboard doc with the mixed-quant recipe. assigned: leo (1,3), jin (2 monitoring hooks).
leo: will do. dropping the PR diff for doc later today.
jin: also add a small eval comparing L2 vs no-norm for short-query bench; some product short-query flows are un-normalized.
maria: agreed. add the k range for recall stability (1..50) in the report.
leo: will attach final artifacts here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
